notes.title: Halloween Survey Event
notes.content:
Hi Everyone!

We've decided to join in on the Halloween fun and also have an event! We have some questions we've been really wanting to ask the community about point-and-click adventure games!

[h3]Fill in this survey below and the first 50 to completely fill in the survey will get a free copy of Silver Creek Falls Chapter 2:[/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/403070/Silver_Creek_Falls_Chapter_2

https://forms.gle/AKHJ7ovmh48m8EzAA

Looking forward to your responses!

Cheers,

The Sapphire Dragon Productions Team
